Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first search for "Otrag headquarters country"), the WebSurfer incorrectly identified the country as the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The search results visible in the screenshot and described in the text clearly show that the top results refer to "OTRAG" (Orbital Transport- und Raketen-Aktiengesellschaft), a German rocket company, with multiple sources (Wikipedia, Encyclopedia Astronautica, Rex Research) explicitly stating it was a West German company. The mention of the Democratic Republic of the Congo appears to be a hallucination or a misinterpretation of unrelated search noise, as no credible source in the provided text links "Otrag" to the DRC. This initial error led to confusion and repeated, unproductive search loops failing to correctly disambiguate the entity.
